candidateFields.canonicalSourceEnglish: The three ethics as three linked circles of equal size: a hand holding soil for Earth Care, two people for People Care, and a basket passing between hands for Fair Share.

candidateFields.canonicalSourceEnglish: Twelve design principles arranged as segments around a central seedling, each shown as a simple picture — an eye for observing, a droplet for catching water, a sun for energy, a loop for returning waste.
candidateFields.proposedTargetText: Misinya ya milawu ya dizayini ya khume-mbirhi yi vekiwile hi swiphemu leswi rhendzeleke ximilana lexi nga exikarhini. Xiphemu xin’wana ni xin’wana xi kombisiwa hi xifaniso xo olova — tihlo ra ku xiyisisa, thonsi ra ku khoma mati, dyambu ra eneji, na xirhendzevutana lexi kombisaka ku vuyisa thyaka.

candidateFields.canonicalSourceEnglish: Illustrated example farm: numbered markers 0 to 5 follow a winding footpath from the house and near garden, past chickens and a field, toward trees and a wilder riverside area. The markers are examples, not fixed boundaries or distances.
candidateFields.proposedTargetText: Xikombiso xa purasi lexi kombisiweke hi swifaniso: tinomboro ta 0 ku ya eka 5 ti landzelela ndlela yo famba hi milenge leyi jikajikaka ku suka endlwini ni le xirhapeni xa le kusuhi, ti hundza tihuku ni nsimu, ti ya eka mirhi ni le ndhawini ya le ribuweni ra nambu leyi nga ya ntumbuluko swinene. Tinomboro leti i swikombiso ntsena; a hi mindzilakano leyi tiyisiweke kumbe mipfhuka leyi tiyisiweke.
